notReleased.packages/orm-rust/Cargo.toml: the Cargo workspace of the Rust crates, no package of its own

notReleased.packages/orm-rust/testcase/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/orm-rust/tests/Cargo.toml: the integration tests of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.bench/rust/Cargo.toml: the benchmark crate of the Rust client
notReleased.tests/interfaces/rust/Cargo.toml: the interface check crate of the Rust client
